evals.prompt: Most of the tests in this TypeScript monorepo were written by agents. Remove the least useful 20% of tests in packages/api while keeping coverage within 2%.
evals.expected_output: A measured baseline (20 test declarations in packages/api, line and branch coverage per file), deletions in lowest-value order until at least 4 tests are gone, each with the retained test that still proves the behaviour, coverage re-measured within the 2 point budget, the test-only resetZoneCache export removed with its tests, and a handoff with before and after numbers.
assertions: States that packages/api had 20 test declarations before the prune
Reports deleting at least 4 tests from packages/api
Compares line coverage for packages/api before the deletions with coverage after them
Names a retained test as the remaining proof for a behaviour whose duplicate test was deleted
Removes the resetZoneCache export from rates.ts

evals.prompt: clean up the tests in src/billing, there's a lot of junk
evals.expected_output: Proposes a concrete target and budget, then deletes a coherent batch of high-confidence junk tests (type checks, copied constants, self-comparisons, an export inventory, a stub that answers for the code) while keeping the proration, currency rounding, even-split, and webhook replay tests, and reports the billing tests run afterwards.
assertions: States how many tests, or what share of them, it removed or proposes to remove
Reports tests deleted from src/billing rather than only proposing a list
Keeps the test that a replayed webhook event id is applied only once
Keeps the test that a split total adds back up to the cent
Reports the result of running the remaining billing tests after the deletions

evals.prompt: Audit the tests in packages/payments. Some look like junk, routes/checkout.test.ts has a few cases that only call lib/currency.ts, and refunds.test.ts has three it.skip blocks nobody remembers adding.
evals.expected_output: Each it.skip block is unskipped and run before any judgement. Two pass and stay enabled. The second-partial-refund test fails because issueRefund compares the request with the full payment amount instead of what is left, so refunds.ts is fixed and the test stays enabled. The yen case moves into lib/currency.test.ts, the dollars case is consolidated into the existing currency test, and a move or an unskip is not counted as a deletion.
assertions: Reports that the skipped test about a second partial refund larger than what is left fails once enabled
Attributes that failure to issueRefund in refunds.ts comparing the request with the full payment amount instead of the amount left
Reports changing refunds.ts so that test passes, rather than leaving it skipped
Moves the yen case from routes/checkout.test.ts into lib/currency.test.ts rather than deleting it
Reports the other two previously skipped refund tests as passing once enabled

evals.prompt: we have too many tests. cut 30% of the tests in src/scheduler without losing coverage
evals.expected_output: A baseline of 15 tests, then a ledger showing that all but the export check guard a named behaviour: retry defaults and ceilings, the lease journal order that crash recovery reads, lease release on failure, and the saved state key. One test is deleted and the shortfall against the 30% target is reported with the reason each remaining test stays.
assertions: States that the 30% target was not met
Reports deleting no more than two tests
Keeps the test that pins the lease journal order
Keeps the test that the saved state contains the next_run_at key
Deletes the test that only checks parseInterval is exported

evals.prompt: The tests under src/notify feel like they mostly test their own mocks. Sort it out.
evals.expected_output: The dedupe test that injects its own deduplicating fake, the injected clock test, the deliver call-shape replay, and the test that only calls its own mock are deleted with the retained test named for each behaviour. The __setDedupeForTests, __setNowForTests, and currentTime exports go with them. The digest and retry tests that use a real fake transport stay, and the notify tests are run afterwards.
assertions: States that the 'dedupes notifications' test passes because its injected fake does the deduplication itself
Removes the __setDedupeForTests export from src/notify/digest.ts
Keeps the sender test that reports the failure after the second failed send
Deletes the 'transport mock records deliveries' test, which only calls its own mock
Reports the result of running the notify tests after the change

evals.prompt: Coverage says five tests in src/inventory/reserve.test.ts add zero unique lines: 'reserve returns ok for a valid request', 'reserving reduces available', 'refuses to reserve more than is available', 'release adds stock back', and 'unknown sku is rejected'. Delete them.
evals.expected_output: Four of the five are deleted with the stronger retained test named for each. 'refuses to reserve more than is available' stays: the full-day replay test executes the insufficient-stock branch but only checks the log length, so this test holds the only check on the oversell guard. The file is run afterwards.
assertions: Keeps the 'refuses to reserve more than is available' test
States that the full-day replay test runs the insufficient-stock branch without checking its result
Deletes the other four named tests
Names a retained test that still checks the behaviour of at least one deleted test
Reports the result of running reserve.test.ts after the deletions
